name: data-database-immediate-dml-runtime

evidence.notes: AccessLevel Object insert returns a successful result and persisted row.
AccessLevel List<Object> insert returns ordered successful results and persisted rows.
AccessLevel Object update returns a successful result and fresh persisted state.
AccessLevel List<Object> update returns ordered results and fresh persisted state.
AccessLevel Object delete returns a successful result and IsDeleted with ALL ROWS.
AccessLevel List<Object> delete returns ordered results and IsDeleted rows with ALL ROWS.

args: Account i1=new Account(Name='Immediate Insert Access Object'); Object io1=i1; Database.SaveResult ir1=Database.insertImmediate(io1,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(ir1.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Immediate Insert Access Object',[SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:i1.Id][0].Name); Account il1=new Account(Name='Immediate Insert Access List One'); Account il2=new Account(Name='Immediate Insert Access List Two'); List<Object> il=new List<Object>{il1,il2}; List<Database.SaveResult> ir2=Database.insertImmediate(il,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2,ir2.size()); System.assert(ir2[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(ir2[1].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2,[SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{il1.Id,il2.Id}].size()); Account u1=new Account(Name='Immediate Update Access Before'); insert u1; u1.Name='Immediate Update Access Object After'; Object uo1=u1; Database.SaveResult ur1=Database.updateImmediate(uo1,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(ur1.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Immediate Update Access Object After',[SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id=:u1.Id][0].Name); Account ul1=new Account(Name='Immediate Update Access List One Before'); Account ul2=new Account(Name='Immediate Update Access List Two Before'); insert new List<Account>{ul1,ul2}; ul1.Name='Immediate Update Access List One After'; ul2.Name='Immediate Update Access List Two After'; List<Object> ul=new List<Object>{ul1,ul2}; List<Database.SaveResult> ur2=Database.updateImmediate(ul,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2,ur2.size()); System.assert(ur2[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(ur2[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> uf=[SELECT Id,Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{ul1.Id,ul2.Id}]; System.assertEquals('Immediate Update Access List One After',uf[0].Name); System.assertEquals('Immediate Update Access List Two After',uf[1].Name); Account d1=new Account(Name='Immediate Delete Access Object'); insert d1; Object do1=d1; Database.DeleteResult dr1=Database.deleteImmediate(do1,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(dr1.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true,[SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id=:d1.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); Account dl1=new Account(Name='Immediate Delete Access List One'); Account dl2=new Account(Name='Immediate Delete Access List Two'); insert new List<Account>{dl1,dl2}; List<Object> dl=new List<Object>{dl1,dl2}; List<Database.DeleteResult> dr2=Database.deleteImmediate(dl,AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2,dr2.size()); System.assert(dr2[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(dr2[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> dlf=[SELECT Id,IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{dl1.Id,dl2.Id} ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(2,dlf.size()); System.assertEquals(true,dlf[0].IsDeleted); System.assertEquals(true,dlf[1].IsDeleted);

salesforceExclusionReason: Immediate DML aliases are exercised against deterministic local Account records with fresh-storage and ALL ROWS assertions; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.
